player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyisitshenziso {player_id} kuChopsticks. Ezinyangeni zakho, khetha lokhu kulokho:
  + Bhalela:  '[attack M O]'  lapho M=indlu yakho (0 noma 1), O=indlu yomdlali odala (0 noma 1).
    - Indlu yomdlali odala inyuka ngokuthi indlu yakho; ikhite kuze kube ngu-5, iyaba ngu-0.
  + Phinda:   '[split L R]'  ukuhambisa kabili indlu yakho yonke kuL na R (L+R = kabili yakho).
Yiphendula ngokulungele ukudla kwezokulunga.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split kufanele igucule indlela yekuhambisa sandla sakho.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kusungula kungemti. Sebenzisa “[attack M O]” noma “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} ibhalela P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: iyaphinda kusuka {opp_val} kuya ku{new_val}.
